title: The owner's third round on the day-42 build: white and yellow hunt the tank or the gate, the garage mends the hull too, the cored skins drawn over the soft ones, sectors 4 and 5 open near, the launcher's magnets one by one, the boards' party face, and THE ARENA secures on the mother's death with the brood dying with her, the Reeds three times the size and the mother afraid of the 40 mm
context: Owner, 2026-10-18 (late), on the round-2 build of day-42, ten notes kept verbatim in the session's ledger (.superpowers/sdd/owner-notes-2026-10-18-round-3.md): 1) a spot to repair the hull, the Stalheart or the paint-job garage; 2) the weaker units faster and more aggressive toward the tank (flank, surround, attack though they cannot) or the gates, whichever is closer; 3) sectors 4 and 5 have the tremor but the first wave seems empty, a long delay before enemies arrive; 4) purple enemies in sector 5 and at the cargo nests still looking white outside; 5) the launcher's magnets should light up in cyan one by one; 6) record Isao's voices for the party and the boards showing '42 days Survived!' and 'CONGRATS! VENI VIDI KICK ASS!'; 7) sector 9's voice lines and SOL clearing the path fifty metres ahead; 8) the lost hand-over scene, the small Reeds three times bigger, the mother walking onto the sinkhole, more aggro, more scared of the 40 mm ('push her to a side 40mm, launch big nuke, time it'); 9) Isao's decoded-messages lines after the mother; 10) killing the mother fails to trigger the next phase. Every stream probed or looked first, then fixed; each reviewed with one fix round where it bit.
outcome: Note 2: src/domain/soft-hunt.js and src/fx/soft-hunt.js replace the 2026-10-16 PEARL_HUNT: a white or yellow picks the hull when its WALKING distance is under the gate's by SOFT_HUNT.bias 2 cells, walks 1.35x / 1.25x on the way, takes a slot on a ring 1.2 cells out (its index mod 8, three layers), circles and lunges short of the ram (a jolt, no damage), re-aims every 0.5 s; the motion audit now measures the hunt (worst white 9.3, yellow 11.2 radii a second; HUNT_CAP 10 / 12). Note 1: HULL_REPAIR.spots ['stalheart', 'garage'], the garage's footprint mends the hull as the Stalheart does (state().hullRepair.where); parking on the pad still opens the paint modal once. Note 4: the cause was draw order, not colour: every membrane is transparent without depth write and a pool created later painted over earlier ones, so purple (the nests' guards, created first) sat inside the whites' and yellows' skins; PEARL_MEMBRANE.order 3 for cored skins over 2 for soft, purple and brown rims and glints fully their own colour, tint 60 %, opacity 0.45. Note 3: the delay was the walk: the first gate breach stood 45 hops out and the Pearl column took 79 s to the gate; sectors 4 and 5 carry nearFirst and open their first gate breach on a 30-hop ring (SECTOR_PLACEMENT.flowFirstHops; the ring as the fallback; the door, BOTH WALLS and the hold sectors unchanged): the first body within 10 cells at 23 s after the tremor, was 55. Note 5: the ARC-01 rail's sixteen passage gates (one merged mesh) are split per launch into sixteen groups and lit bottom to top over the charge (LAUNCHER_LIGHTS step 0.25 s, ramp 0.15 s, tied to LAUNCH.chargeAt), merged back after the release. Note 6: the two scoreboards wear a party face from the party's start to its end (DAY_42.boards, a canvas plane over the glyph runtime that has no '!'). Note 10: THE ARENA could only read SECURE once every live body on the planet was dead and the door sector closes with 49-70 alive that walk in: the boss sector's SECURE is now the mother dead (src/domain/boss-sector.js bossLeft: alive or queued), the brood (the arena's small Reeds and pups) dies with her 0.1 s apart, boss_dead is said at her death; harness damageBoss, aliveBodies, spawnFar({ tier, hunter }); --arena kills her with a stray alive. Note 8b: the small Reeds size 3 at 4 hp (ownSize kept through the tune panel's retune). Note 8c: BOSS_FIGHT.arenaBoss: she crosses to the sinkhole's centre and stands 6 s before hunting, walks 1.4x, flees 3.2 s from each 40 mm hit (re-aimed by each shell), the MK-9 holds her 1.5 s; the 25 mm, the strike and SOL do not move her. Notes 7, 8a, 9: arena_go is 'Other side of the planet. You must check it out.' / 'Seems big.'; arena_road 'Let me clear a path for you.' at the first cut; SOL cuts only the road rocks 3.2 to 5 cells ahead of the hull along the planned road, looked for every 0.25 s, the look running again during a burn once the hull is within clear + 1 cells of the held rock (ARENA.road.aheadMetres 50; measured lead up to 4.86 cells); THE MOTHER card over the paused game when she rises (ARENA_HANDOVER: Isao's arena_force lines, the seat's real controls from GUNSHIP_SEAT_HINT shared with the seat's footer, one button TAKE THE GUN, then the forced seat); at her death the boss phase ends, the hull's directive and autopilot go back to the player's, the seat is left, boss_dead is said and arena_decoded ('I have decoded some of their messages.' / 'They have a nest and a Queen down there.' / 'Someone must go there.' / 'I am a poet and a builder, not a warrior.') follows it, the debrief waiting until Isao has finished (ARENA.decodedCap 20 s); BOTH WALLS still sits between the arena and the descent (the owner's 'between end of Nih Dairia and going in' may expect the cave next: not reordered).
alternatives: Keeping PEARL_HUNT's 10-cell range: the owner's 'whichever is closer' has no range; a parked tank now pulls a whole wave off the base (his call in play).
Tinting purple's skin further or thinner: the skin was purple close up; the white was other pools' skins drawn over it.
A nearer first breach for every flow sector: the door, BOTH WALLS and the hold sectors have tuned fights and one gate breach; the flag sits on rows 4 and 5 only.
Lighting the gates one per countdown second: the launcher has no countdown; the charge is the beat.
Letting the brood live after the mother: hunters would walk at the hull into BOTH WALLS with Isao no longer luring; the mother is the fight.
evidence: test/soft-hunt.mjs, test/pearl-motion.mjs (the measured hunt), test/hull-repair.mjs, test/pearl-enemies.mjs (the layer order and glints), test/sector-run.mjs (nearFirst, the fallback, the door's ring), test/light-sequence.mjs (the model split into sixteen), test/scoreboard-face.mjs, test/boss-run.mjs (the brood), test/boss-sector.mjs; npm test 279 programs; npm run architecture (td-tab 6,189 of 6,400)
